acceptance_for_future_review: Exact input and source pins remain unchanged before and after.
Each target resolves to a unique CO2/isotope-1/flag-1 main by transformed center and line identity; if not unique, report ambiguous and stop.

Raw negative-IFLG companion bytes decode through the documented REAL(4) MOL transfer; compare the resulting A/B tuple and 200–250 K interpolated YI/GI against trace values, preserving exact and ULP differences.
Associate each companion only from LNFL sequence/state and record ordering; do not infer self/foreign role from neighboring center alone.
Any discrepancy remains a representation/association finding only until source and calculation implications are separately established.

input_identity.TAPE3_source: existing saved coupled LNFL output in the original preserved r3term case; run-v6 generated from the frozen AER v3.8.1 combined line file

limitations: This preparation does not establish raw bytes or companion association for any target.
The copied TAPE3 is restricted-use AER-derived data; no bytes are copied into this package.
No line-support truncation behavior is changed or judged here.
No physical-validity conclusion is made from negative optical-depth operands.
planned_reader: read_selected_tape3_groups.py: one bounded streaming pass over only the saved 122 MB TAPE3 sequential records; retains only nearby CO2 main candidates and their immediately following companion rows, preserving all relevant source scalar bytes as hex. It does not read ODdeflt output arrays or execute LBLRTM.

planned_run_control.child_rc_capture: A future one-use wrapper should durably store actual child RC before reading the report, then record report hash and input post-pins. Do not launch until root reviews/authorizes.

source_contract.TAPE3_record_layout: GNU sequential-unformatted little-endian; 4-byte record markers; 1664-byte file header; 24-byte block header; each fixed data record is 9750 four-byte words/250 slots. Read only nlines slots.
source_contract.companion_interpolation: LNCOR1 uses companion slot fields as A(1..4)=(VNU,S,ALFA,EPP), B(1..4)=(AMOL,HWHMS,TMPALF,PSHIFT). For IFLAG=1 at TAVE=228.3152 K, the source nodes are TEMPLC=(200,250,296,340) K and use the 200–250 K segment: A/B first and second values linearly interpolate with RECTLC=1/50 and TMPDIF=TAVE-200. Do not round/decode MOL payload as integer species.
source_contract.input_block_types: VNU REAL(8); SP, ALFA, EPP, HWHM, TMPALF, PSHIFT REAL(4); MOL/IFLG INTEGER(4).
source_contract.line_center: OPROP adjusts main line center by RHORAT*PSHIFT before selecting/interpolating. With IBRD=0, the guarded broadener-specific shift term is inactive. The reader will emit raw and transformed centers and rank candidates; no candidate is accepted solely by nearest-center proximity.
source_contract.negative_IFLG_path: RDLIN and RDLNFL reinterpret exactly the 4 MOL bytes as REAL(4), promote to working precision and TRANSFER into AMOL storage. This is intentional companion encoding; preserve original hex and decoded REAL(4) bits.
source_contract.role_semantics: LNFL source states IFLGM1=1 or 3 means foreign line coupling; IFLGM1=5 carries both foreign and self coupling. These traced mains are expected flag 1, so inspect as foreign-coupling groups. Do not infer self-coupling companion merely from CO2 species; verify actual flag/group sequence.

target_records.expected_relationship: Source LNCOR1 applies VNU_work=VNU_raw+RHORAT*PSHIFT at layer state; with IBRD=0 the optional extra-broadener shift correction is inactive. Search candidates by (molecule,isotope,main flag) and transformed center; report nearest alternatives, do not use a broad match alone as association proof.
